title: Benefits of using the AEO ERM - Uganda Revenue Authority
text:
# Benefits of using the AEO ERM
Benefits to URA  Enhance international trade facilitation through strengthened inter-agency and regional cooperation.  Enhance tax compliance through simplified and predictable business processes, and integrated information systems.  Reduced cost of doing business as a result of decrease in the dwell time.  Optimally utilize resources through sharing information, infrastructure and a clearance system across agencies.  Improve compliance through risk based and intelligence led interventions.  Foster legitimate trade through enhancing international supply chain security.  Improve revenue collection as a result of simplified procedures and automated systems  Trade Facilitative Controls Benefits to Individuals  Reduced cost of doing business as a result of decrease in the dwell time.  Transparency with auto notification of each change of status of any cargo under customs control to importer and other interested party.  Ease of tracking accurate cargo status by warehouse operator, Importer, agent, consolidator, security, or any interested party.  Enhances predictability and hence good planning for all parties on given cargo.  Enhances coordinated quality service delivered with integrity and transparence.
